examples.scenario: A .msk sidecar marks a cell valid while the raster nodata metadata marks the same value invalid
examples.reason: The authoritative validity source must be bound and the conflict disclosed before the cell can enter statistics.

examples.scenario: A valid low elevation was scaled to UInt8 value 0, which is also the declared nodata sentinel
examples.reason: Value equality alone cannot distinguish valid low data from missing data after lossy scaling.

examples.scenario: A multiband warp uses GDAL PARTIAL mode but the prior run used NO mode
examples.reason: Different unified nodata modes can change target validity and alpha output.

examples.scenario: A parcel intersects 20 geometric cells but only 7 cells have valid native DTM samples
examples.reason: An extrema result from sparse support cannot be presented as a complete parcel height range.

examples.scenario: Two adjacent DEM tiles use -999999 nodata but leave a one-cell invalid seam through the parcel
examples.reason: Official DEM delivery rules reject edge artifacts and the seam can hide the true extrema.

examples.scenario: The all-touched mask admits a high corner-touch cell that centre inclusion excludes
examples.reason: The cell-inclusion rule materially changes the maximum and must be fixed before value inspection.

examples.scenario: Warp interpolation receives no valid source pixels for a target cell
examples.reason: A fabricated zero or interpolated elevation must not replace missing support.

examples.scenario: A parcel has 98 percent valid cells but one contiguous void covers the only steep slope area
examples.reason: A high global ratio can hide a spatially important void, so void topology must accompany the ratio.
